recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned profile portrait of a man singing, set against a deep black background. The subject is illuminated by a strong side-light that highlights skin texture and perspiration, while the lower third is occupied by a highly detailed, warm-toned patterned garment. The top right corner features stylized, multi-layered neon-style lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the deep black void and the warm, textured subject
Juxtaposition of organic human form with geometric, glowing typography
Balance between the heavy visual weight of the patterned clothing and the negative space above
coreInvariants: Deep black background with no visible environment
High-key highlights on the face to show moisture/texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, looking toward the right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's lit face and teeth provide the primary focal point, anchored by the dense pattern of the clothing below.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright face, follows the gaze to the right, and then moves up to the glowing typography in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the upper left and center-right creates a sense of intimacy and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm Amber and Ochre (Skin and Clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black background and the bright highlights; saturation is concentrated in the warm tones and the neon outlines.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and neon accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded, wide sans-serif with interlocking and overlapping strokes
letterConstructionRules: Double or triple-line outlines mimicking neon tubes
Interlocking characters where strokes of one letter flow into the next
Variable line weight in the 'glow' effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal bars that connect adjacent letters
Open counters with internal glow lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking two distinct neon colors (e.g., Green over Orange) to differentiate hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the rounded, geometric skeleton for the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A close-up profile of a man singing with an expressive, joyful face, sweat visible on his skin under warm stage lighting. He wears a highly detailed 1970s-style patterned shirt in gold and brown tones. The background is pure, deep black. Analog film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of custom neon-style lettering in the top right. The top line should have a green glow outline and the bottom line an orange glow outline. Use rounded, overlapping, tubular letterforms.

verificationChecks: Does the skin have a warm, sweaty highlight?
Are the letters constructed as multi-line neon outlines?
Is the clothing pattern intricate and warm-toned?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the face
Check that the neon glow doesn't bleed excessively into the black
Verify the pattern on the shirt feels textile-based, not digital
Confirm the skin tones remain in the warm amber spectrum
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast soulful profile portrait [Subject] with [Patterned Clothing] against [Black Background], topped with [Neon Outline Typography] in the [Top Right Corner].
